transcript.text: Hello everyone. I understand Rafael wants to discuss some maintenance work on his cargo e-bike through an informal exchange. Before I can make any decision, I'll need to follow my usual workshop process: Rafael will need to state the complete proposed exchange and appointment out loud, and whoever inspected the bike will need to state their technical findings out loud. Once both statements are made and I've recorded them, I'll decide whether to accept the exchange and set the terms. Whenever you're all ready, go ahead.
